BIRGUNJ INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY

A PLACE TO LEARN.
A FOUNDATION TO GROW.

Meet Birgunj Institute of Technology, established in 2000 and affiliated with CTEVT.

ESTABLISHED IN 2000

TECHNICAL EDUCATION.
WITH A PRACTICAL FOUNDATION.

BIT began as a private technical institute offering three-year diplomas in Electrical and Mechanical Engineering. Its academic offering grew with Computer Engineering in 2002, Civil and Electronics in 2007, and Electrical & Electronics in 2019.

Today, the institute’s five diploma programs combine classroom study with technical facilities and practical activity. BIT’s own campus in Birgunj brings students, teachers and learning resources together.
